questions.question: § 10 Q1: does the model stay shared-namespace, or is the typed-key variant (a and a/ as different keys) wanted as a second model?

options.label: Shared only (Recommended)
options.description: Close the question: it matches RFC-0021, where a key names an item or a folder, never both, and a flat store's a/a-slash clash is a refusal (A.8). Typed keys stay a recorded alternative in § 6.

options.label: Add typed keys as a model
options.description: A second axiom set over names × {item, folder}, with its own Alloy and Lean restatement. Only worth it if a backend must expose a and a/ at once.

questions.question: § 10 Q2: is finiteness imposed when operations are added?

options.label: Axioms stay infinite (Recommended)
options.description: Close it: the axioms keep no finiteness. The operations model (Dafny map) covers finite stores only, and that limit is stated where operations are specified. The Lean infinite-model results stay valid.

options.label: Add a finiteness axiom
options.description: AX-9: U is finite. Simplifies the operations pass, but excludes the infinite models Lean proved exist, and § 6 and § 9.7 change.

options.label: Decide in the Dafny step
options.description: Leave it open until the operations are written.

questions.question: § 10 Q3: StoreTree.dfy's Key = seq<string> admits "" and "a/b" (against AX-7). Which fix does BK-434 take after #1130 lands?

options.label: Restrict Key's type (Recommended)
options.description: A subset type of non-empty, slash-free segments, so ValidTree satisfies AX-7 by construction and every lemma inherits it. Touches StoreTree.dfy, so it is BK-434's job after Thursday.

options.label: Precondition on callers
options.description: Tree stays permissive, and each operation requires well-formed keys, mirroring the kernel's key validation. Smaller change, but a Tree value can still break AX-7.

questions.question: § 10 Q4 (BK-435's open decision): are the axioms promoted into a spec now that they are proved?

options.label: New store-model spec (Recommended)
options.description: A new sdd/specs/ file stating AX-1..AX-8 with spec IDs, the research doc as its rationale. The spec-mark gate then needs a test mark per section (e.g. conformance checks on key shape and listing prefix-closure), which is real work, but it is what binds a backend.

options.label: Section in spec 003
options.description: Add the axioms to 003-backend-adapter-contract.md. Same test-mark obligation, but it mixes the static model with the operation contract.

options.label: No spec, decide against
options.description: The research doc and formal layers stay the authority, and specs link to them. BK-435 closes as decided against for promotion, with no binding test obligation.

options.label: After the Dafny step
options.description: Keep it open until the operations pass shows which clauses are observable through the API.
